title: 02  /  HydroSense system flowchart
subtitle: Water filtration and ESP32 operation | Based on thesis V23, pp. 60-62 and Appendix I | See Flowchart 01 for app navigation

nodes.text:
1,000 L output tank
Non-potable domestic use

Read app mode and pump commands
when Firebase is ready; read ToF tank
level, float switches and leak sensor

Stop both pumps;
reset Pump A cycle timer

Stop both pumps; clear manual
pump commands locally and
in Firebase when available

MANUAL
Apply latest Pump A / Pump B commands
Safety overrides still take priority

AUTO: evaluate catchment floats
FS1 down + FS2 down: A enabled; B OFF
FS1 up + FS2 down: A enabled; B ON
FS1 up + FS2 up: A OFF; B ON
FS1 down + FS2 up: A OFF; B OFF

If A enabled: cycle 30 s ON / 60 s OFF
Otherwise keep A OFF; apply B state

Apply / retain relay outputs;
update actual pump state

When cloud is ready:
publish changed pump states;
publish sensor data and runtime
at the telemetry interval

Refresh local LCD and
Firebase-fed Android views

notes.text: Water route: biofilter media and the downstream five-stage treatment are distinct assemblies (thesis pp. 61-62).

Control polling and pump / safety checks: 500 ms
pH, processed TDS and turbidity: about 1 s
TDS raw samples: 40 ms
Sensor + runtime telemetry: 5 s
Local LCD: 2 s; pump status: on change

App writes mode and pump commands to Firebase.
App reads sensor values and actual relay state.
Filter model is trained on generated data and
uses measured Pump B runtime for live estimates.

FS1 = lower catchment float
FS2 = upper catchment float
A = intake pump; B = filter-feed pump
U = relay update / reporting step
R = next main-loop pass

Leak and full-tank overrides
apply in both AUTO and MANUAL.

footer: Timing and branch details follow Appendix I code. The prose on p. 62 differs on telemetry timing and the full-tank inequality.
Firmware uses a 5-second telemetry interval and a >=100% full-tank stop. Local safety logic continues without a cloud connection.
Sources: physical route, pp. 61-62; existing overview, p. 60; controller constants and safety / AUTO branches, pp. 166-177.
